title: MeshPack Integrity Sidecar
description: Detached integrity verification file for MeshPack archives (*.meshpack.integrity). Required because pack_hash cannot be computed and stored inside the archive itself. This is the AUTHORITATIVE source for pack_hash and signatures.

pack_size_bytes.description: Size of the .meshpack file in bytes, for quick sanity check before hashing

hash_algo.description: Algorithm used to compute pack_hash. MUST match manifest.hash_algo.

pack_hash.description: The AUTHORITATIVE hash of the .meshpack archive bytes (excluding items listed in 'exclusions'). Verifiers MUST use this value, not manifest.pack_hash.

computed_at.description: When this sidecar was generated (ISO 8601 UTC)

exclusions.description: List of ZIP entry paths excluded from hash computation (e.g., mapping.db which is non-deterministic)

signatures.description: Cryptographic signatures over pack_hash for authenticity verification

signature.description: Base64-encoded signature over the pack_hash string bytes

signer_id.description: Optional identifier of the signer (email, key ID, etc.)
